final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rented_films FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), shares AS (SELECT rating, rented_films, 1.0 * rented_films / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), above_average AS (SELECT rented_films, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(rented_films) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_above_average FROM above_average
